scripts.dev: npm run build:core && npm run dev --workspace server
scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build --workspace client && npm run build --workspace server
scripts.test: npm run build:core && node --import tsx --test tests/*.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.format: prettier --write client/src server/src packages tests playwright.config.ts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check client/src server/src packages tests playwright.config.ts
